skills.name: E—Excuse Me, Please!
skills.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Misha's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: R—Room Service!
skills.desc: Increases the Hits Per Action for Misha's next Ultimate by #3[i] hit(s). Deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Misha's ATK to one designated enemy target, and Ice DMG equal to #2[i]% of Misha's ATK to adjacent targets.

skills.name: G—Gonna Be Late!
skills.desc:
Has #1[i] Hits Per Action by default. First, uses 1 hit to deal Ice DMG equal to #2[i]% of Misha's ATK to one designated enemy target. Then, the rest of the hits each deals Ice DMG equal to #2[i]% of Misha's ATK to one random enemy. Just before each hit lands, there is a #3[f1]% base chance to Freeze the target, lasting for 1 turn.
While Frozen, enemy targets cannot take any actions, and at the start of their turn, they receive Ice Additional DMG equal to #4[i]% of Misha's ATK.
This Ultimate can possess up to #5[i] Hits Per Action. After the Ultimate is used, its Hits Per Action will be reset to the default level.

skills.name: Horological Escapement
skills.desc: For every 1 Skill Point allies consume, Misha's next Ultimate delivers #2[i] more Hit(s) Per Action, and Misha regenerates #1[f1] Energy.

skills.name: Wait, You Are So Beautiful!
skills.desc: After using the Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for #1[i] seconds. Enemies caught in the Special Dimension are inflicted with Dream Prison and stop all their actions. Upon entering battle against enemies afflicted with Dream Prison, increases the Hits Per Action for Misha's next Ultimate by #2[i] hit(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

passives.name: Release
passives.desc: Before the Ultimate's first hit, increases the base chance of Freezing the target by 80%.

passives.name: Interlock
passives.desc: When using the Ultimate, increases the Effect Hit Rate by 60%, lasting until the end of the current Ultimate's action.

passives.name: Transmission
passives.desc: When dealing DMG to Frozen enemies, increases CRIT DMG by 30%.
